objective: Parse an already-authenticated Telnyx webhook raw body and delegate supported voice lifecycle semantics to the landed Telnyx voice-event normalizer without duplicating provider event rules.

inputBoundary.rawBody: Exact webhook body text after successful INS-002F1 authentication.
inputBoundary.authentication: Required by caller before invoking this F2 adapter; F2 performs no signature verification.

invariants: JSON parsing occurs only after signature verification at the caller boundary.
Existing normalizeTelnyxVoiceEvent remains the sole owner of provider semantic normalization.
Unsupported Telnyx event types do not advance canonical state.
Malformed recognized Telnyx events are represented as invalid-payload.
Raw provider payload fields are not retained beyond the canonical TelnyxVoiceEvent shape.
providerEventId and callControlId remain exactly those produced by the landed normalizer.
next: INS-002F3 may map application outcomes to deterministic webhook acknowledgement and retry semantics.
